text:
Given:  
\[
\rho=880\ \text{kg m}^{-3},\quad \mu=0.12\ \text{Pa·s},\quad Q=1.5\ \text{L s}^{-1}=1.5\times10^{-3}\ \text{m}^3\text{/s}
\]
\[
D=40\ \text{mm}=0.040\ \text{m},\quad L=25\ \text{m}
\]

First find average velocity:
\[
A=\frac{\pi D^2}{4}=\frac{\pi(0.040)^2}{4}=1.2566\times10^{-3}\ \text{m}^2
\]
\[
v=\frac{Q}{A}=\frac{1.5\times10^{-3}}{1.2566\times10^{-3}}=1.194\ \text{m/s}
\]

### (a) Reynolds number
\[
\text{Re}=\frac{\rho v D}{\mu}=\frac{(880)(1.194)(0.040)}{0.12}=3.50\times10^{2}
\]
Flow is laminar since Re \(\ll 2100\).

### (b) Darcy friction factor
For fully developed laminar flow in a circular tube:
\[
f=\frac{64}{\text{Re}}=\frac{64}{350}=0.183
\]

### (c) Frictional pressure drop
Darcy–Weisbach:
\[
\Delta P=f\frac{L}{D}\left(\frac{\rho v^2}{2}\right)
\]
\[
\frac{L}{D}=\frac{25}{0.040}=625
\]
\[
\frac{\rho v^2}{2}=\frac{880(1.194^2)}{2}=\frac{880(1.425)}{2}=627\ \text{Pa}
\]
\[
\Delta P=(0.183)(625)(627)=7.17\times10^{4}\ \text{Pa}=71.7\ \text{kPa}
\]

FINAL (a): 350 dimensionless  
FINAL (b): 0.183 dimensionless  
FINAL (c): 71.7 kPa
